# SHA-256 of lower-case identity tokens (the maintainer's username and name parts) and their length,
# one '<sha256> <length>' per line. This only keeps the literal name out of the check's own source:
# it is obfuscation, not secrecy (a short token falls to brute force, and the name is public in the
# author fields and CODEOWNERS anyway). Never list a token that is not already public, such as a
# private second name or handle. Not covered (accepted residuals): base64 or hex encodings, tokens
# glued to other letters or digits, and homoglyphs outside Unicode compatibility folding.
